officialTitle: The Agentic Probe: The Instrument of Agentic Discovery & Engineering

chapters.title: Introduction and the research behind agentic probes
The shift from agentic engineering to discovery
A personal view of the current AI landscape
Agentic probes: making problems and solutions tangible
Takeaways: discovery, engineering and moving bottlenecks

existingSummary: Tapio Pitkäranta presents agentic probes as tangible experiments for exploring problems and testing possible solutions. Drawing on research with Leena Pitkäranta, he describes a probe factory, agentic search and a healthcare process example, while asking how discovery changes as implementation becomes faster.
